request.style: English, male voice, gravelly solo, upright bass, piano, acoustic guitar, slow burn, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Unless the Lord builds the house
Builders labor in vain
Unless He watches the city
Guardians keep guard in vain

[Pre-Chorus]
Rise early and stay up late
Bread of anxious toil
But He gives sleep
To the one He loves

[Chorus]
Children are a heritage from the Lord
The fruit of the womb is a reward
A heritage from the Lord
A reward from on high

[Verse]
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior
So are the sons of youth
How blessed is the man
Whose quiver is full

[Pre-Chorus]
They will not be put to shame
When they contend at the gate
The Lord builds your house
The Lord watches your city

[Chorus]
Children are a heritage from the Lord
The fruit of the womb is a reward
A heritage from the Lord
A reward from on high

[Bridge]
Arrows in the hand of a warrior
Sons of one's youth
Blessed is the man
Full of them

[Chorus]
Children are a heritage from the Lord
The fruit of the womb is a reward
A heritage from the Lord
A reward from on high
